# Key Features:
- Kimi K3: 2.8T parameters. 1M context. It leads the field in coding, agentic tasks, long-horizon reasoning, visual understanding, and agent swarm capabilities.
- Visual Agentic Slides: Upload your visual references, and Kimi will customize the exact visual style you need. Generate professionally formatted, highly personalized presentations with just one click.
- Game Generation: One prompt in, an AAA multiplayer 3D game out. It can build the world, characters, levels, and combat on its own — playtesting and polishing until the visuals stun and every hit lands.
- Agent Swarm: Whether it's massive literature reviews, wide research, or ultra-long industry report writing, it can dynamically deploy up to 300 sub-agents to execute 4000 steps, compressing work that once took hours into minute-level delivery, achieving over 10x efficiency gains.
- Plugins: Connect to authoritative data sources like Wind and S&P. Professional data at your fingertips, for trustworthy analysis.
- Multi-Claw Group Chat: You can now pull the Claws into a group chat and invite human friends for real-time interaction and parallel collaboration. 
- Sync Across Devices: Seamlessly switch between phone, computer, and web. Your conversations stay in sync in real time.
- Office Agent: Kimi Agent is now with Office Pilot. It not only supports lossless swaps across PPT, Word, Excel, and PDF, but also delivers human-expert level processing. 
- Vibe Coding: Deliver a production-ready website with cinematic visuals in just one prompt. 
- Intelligent Vision: Analyze images and photos, making sense of visual data and providing instant feedback.
